d.d: Abbreviation of ignition.
Initialism of in-game name.
Pertaining to or having the nature of fire; containing fire; resembling fire.
d.x: The stone had an igneous appearance.

d.d: Resulting from, or produced by, great heat. With rocks, it could also mean formed from lava or magma.
d.x: Granite and basalt are igneous rocks.

Not noble; plebeian; common.
